_about: Scam Pattern Ledger deterministic summary screen (design brief §2). Each case: raw summary -> expected sanitised text and the first failing check. reason "" = passes. Check order: digits, email_or_handle, amount, url. contracts/pattern_ledger.py (_sanitise_summary, _pii_reason) and relayer/src/lib/pattern.ts (sanitiseSummary, screenSummary) must both match every case. All texts are fictional.
